profile.faqDueDateQ: How do I change my due date?
profile.faqDueDateA: Go to Profile › Your pregnancy and tap Edit. Enter your current week of pregnancy and your due date updates automatically.
profile.faqLanguageQ: How do I change the app language?
profile.faqLanguageA: Go to Profile › Language and choose English, Spanish, Portuguese or Haitian Creole. The whole app switches right away.
profile.faqRemindersQ: How do I turn reminders on or off?
profile.faqRemindersA: Go to Profile › Notifications. You can turn medication and hydration reminders on or off at any time.
profile.faqLogDataQ: How do I log my health data?
profile.faqLogDataA: On the Home screen, tap a card such as Water, Steps or Blood pressure to add an entry. You can also ask your concierge, for example "log 2 glasses of water".

selfCare.title: Self Care
selfCare.intro: Self-care during pregnancy is crucial for both the mother's and baby's well-being.
selfCare.intro2: Prioritizing physical and mental health through healthy habits, relaxation techniques, and social support can help manage stress, improve mood, and prepare for motherhood.
selfCare.intro3: Key Aspects of Self-Care During Pregnancy:

nutrition.title: Nutrition:
nutrition.description: Consume a balanced diet rich in essential nutrients, including folate, iron, calcium, and protein.

exercise.title: Exercise:
exercise.description: Engage in regular, low-impact exercise like walking, swimming, or prenatal yoga, according to ACOG.

hydration.title: Hydration:
hydration.description: Drink 8-12 cups of water daily to stay hydrated and energized, says the ACOG.

sleep.title: Sleep:
sleep.description: Prioritize good sleep to manage stress, improve mood, and enhance energy levels.

stressManagement.title: Stress Management:
stressManagement.description: Practice relaxation techniques like deep breathing, meditation, or progressive muscle relaxation.

socialSupport.title: Social Support:
socialSupport.description: Seek support from family, friends, or join prenatal support groups to manage anxiety and uncertainty.

selfReflection.title: Self-Reflection:
selfReflection.description: Engage in activities that bring joy and relaxation, such as reading, taking baths, or pursuing hobbies.

education.title: Education:
education.description: Educate yourself about pregnancy changes and the birthing process to feel more in control.

prenatalCare.title: Prenatal Care:
prenatalCare.description: Attend regular prenatal appointments with your healthcare provider.

limitStressors.title: Limit Exposure to Stressors:
limitStressors.description: Identify triggers of anxiety and limit exposure to them.

listenToBody.title: Listen to Your Body:
listenToBody.description: Adjust your routine and activities based on your body's needs.

questions.q1-h: Will you and the baby share a room or will they have their own?
questions.q1-i: Will you and the baby share a room or will they have their own?
questions.q1-2: Are you worried about losing your housing in the near future?
questions.q1-smoke: Does anyone who lives in the home or that you are around a lot smoke?
questions.q1-smoke-info:
Preventory measures for second hand smoke:
• Avoid smoky environments and ask others not to smoke
• Keep windows open or use air purifiers at home
• Educate household members on dangers to mother and baby
questions.q1-chemicals: Does anyone in your home or who comes to your home a lot work in a factory or with chemicals?
questions.q1-chemicals-info: Have them change their clothes, shoes and shower before coming in the home. Do not wash their work clothes. Explain why-potential exposure to chemicals
questions.q1-3: Have any utility companies threatened to shut off your services?
questions.q1-4: Any trouble getting to medical appointments or work due to transportation?
questions.q1-5: Do you feel safe where you live?
questions.q1-6: Any concerns about your neighborhood, or safety?
questions.q1-neighborhood: Do you feel safe in your neighborhood?
questions.q1-unsafe-reason: What would make you feel safer?
questions.q1-home-unsafe: Does anyone in your home make you feel unsafe because of physical or verbal abuse?
questions.q1-highway: Do you live close to a highway or area with a lot of car and truck traffic?
questions.q1-windows: Do you open the windows for air?
questions.q1-exhaust-info: Trucks and car's exhaust can put out harmful chemicals
questions.q1-construction: Is there construction on old homes or businesses near your home?
questions.q1-lead-info: Try to keep the windows closed so you are breathing in less dust from outside and the home. This can cause lead poisoning.

conversationalQuestionnaire.timeQuestion: Hey there, do you have a few minutes for a health questionnaire?

introMessages.intro1: I'm here to support you throughout your pregnancy journey. I'd like to better understand your situation to provide personalized guidance.
introMessages.intro2: Many factors in our lives—like housing, food access, support systems, and more—can affect our health and wellbeing during pregnancy.
introMessages.intro3: I'd like to ask you some questions about your life circumstances. This will help me connect you with useful resources and information. Everything you share is confidential, and you can skip any questions that make you uncomfortable.

continue.basicQuestion: Would you like to continue with more questions, or would you prefer to take a break?
continue.domainTransition: That completes this section. Would you like to continue to questions about {{domain}}, or would you prefer to take a break?
continue.clarification: I'm asking if you'd like to continue with more questions now, or if you'd prefer to pause and come back later. You can say 'yes' to continue or 'no' to pause.
continue.domainClarification: I'm asking if you'd like to continue with questions about {{domain}} now, or if you'd prefer to pause and come back later. You can say 'yes' to continue or 'no' to pause.

responses.noTime: No problem! We can continue this conversation whenever you have more time. Just let me know when you're ready.
responses.pauseConfirmation: I've saved your progress. We can continue whenever you're ready - just let me know.
responses.thankYou: Thank you for sharing this information with me. Understanding these aspects of your life helps me provide better support and connect you with resources that can address any challenges you're facing. Remember, you're not alone, and there are organizations ready to assist you.
responses.welcomeBack: Welcome back! Let's continue where we left off.
